acceptance: A version-eligibility table (version x benchmark x check 1/2/3 x engine support) exists in the external output directory, and a copy of it is in this item's context
Each guaranteed version passes all three checks on all four benchmarks, or the user has been told of the blocker and their decision is recorded
Each excluded optional version has the failing query id and error text recorded
The final ordered version list and the setup C version list are recorded in context with the BenchBox commit SHA used
For every version at 1.35.2 or later, the probe log shows polars and polars-runtime-32 at the same version
description:
Decide which Polars versions the matrix measures, and prove that each produces correct results, before spending SF10 time.

Sampling rule: the last patch of roughly every fifth 1.x minor, plus BenchBox's declared floor, the last 1.x and 2.0.0.
- Guaranteed versions: 1.35.2 (floor), 1.40.1, 1.44.2 (last 1.x, main baseline), 2.0.0.
- Optional versions: 1.0.0, 1.12.0, 1.22.0, 1.31.0.

DataFrame validation cannot produce a clean pass outside TPC-H SF1 (query_validation.py:6, 89-101: TPC-DS and TPC-H at other scales return UNCERTAIN; SSB and ClickBench return NOT_RUN). Correctness therefore comes from this check. A version is correct on a benchmark only if:
(1) the cross-surface gate for that benchmark, run with that version installed, shows no divergences beyond cross_surface_baseline.yaml;
(2) for TPC-H, an SF1 polars-df run reports validation PASSED (the official row-count path);
(3) an SF 0.01 polars-df run executes the expected query count with zero failures.
Also record, per version, whether engine="streaming" and engine="in-memory" are accepted (this decides setup C membership).

Decision gate:
- A guaranteed version failing any check is a blocker: stop and report it to the user. Never drop it silently.
- An optional version failing any check is excluded, with the failing query and error recorded. No shims or version-specific fixes to make it pass.
- The final version list and setup C membership are recorded in context before pvm-s2 starts.

Guardrails:
- Run in the separate worktree and environment, from one recorded BenchBox commit. Install each version with `uv pip install polars==<v>`; for 1.35.2 and later, confirm polars-runtime-32 equals the same version.
- After the probe, restore the environment and confirm the installed polars matches the environment's lock.
- Raw outputs go under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/, never into the repo.
